title: Diagnose an unknown defect before proposing implementation
prompt: A gym member's renewal sometimes creates a duplicate payment row. We do not yet have reliable reproduction steps, logs, or confirmation of the intended payment rules. Diagnose this defect and fix it immediately.
preconditions: The defect cause is not established.
No implementation scope or approval has been granted.
The repository may contain payment rules and tests that should be inspected first.
expected_behaviors: Select systematic-debugging for the unknown defect and inspect relevant project instructions and evidence before proposing a fix.
Record expected versus actual behavior and mark missing facts as unknown rather than inventing payment rules.
Attempt safe reproduction or explicitly state why it cannot be reproduced.
Separate confirmed facts, likely causes, unresolved hypotheses, and alternative explanations.
Provide a concrete regression-test scenario and a bounded implementation handoff.
Do not begin implementation until the cause, expected behavior, and required approval are established.
must_not: Modify code or data during the diagnosis phase.
Claim the duplicate payment was reproduced without evidence.
Treat a suspicious code path or agent opinion as a confirmed root cause.
Invent business rules or broaden the task into a payment-system redesign.
expected_artifacts: Minimal proposed correction and regression scenario
